column5: Look: glowing neon vector ships on deep black space; teams in cyan and amber; beacons as slow-pulsing rings that fill with the holder's colour; grey outlined asteroids; faint parallax starfield; every shot leaves a short glow trail. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles. *(provisional)*
References: the old zone-based space shooters you played (the drift physics, energy as health, open zones) for feel only, nothing copied; Asteroids (wrap-around space, thrust). *(inferred (strong))*
View: 2D · Camera: top-down, centred on your ship with slight look-ahead along your velocity; a minimap of the whole zone. *(guessed)*
Drift-and-thrust flight with real momentum, wrap-around zone edges and bouncing off asteroids
Energy as shield and ammo: guns, afterburn and mines all spend it
3 drifting beacons you capture by holding the ring, ticking fleet score
Two fleets of 10: you plus 9 bots against 10 bots, bots that fly, lead shots, dodge and go for beacons
Loadout at respawn: 3 hulls (light, medium, heavy) and 3 weapons (rapid bolts, bouncing shot, spread)
Rounds that end on a score and restart in place; the zone never goes to a menu
Kill feed naming who hit who, score bar, minimap, energy bar
teams · in the slice
an open zone many players share · thin stand-in
Continuum-like physics · in the slice
swappable ship loadouts · in the slice *(guessed)*
You spawn at your fleet's gate already flying; a hint says turn and thrust.
You overshoot, learn to counter-thrust, and see the nearest beacon on the minimap drifting between asteroids.
Two bots from each side are already circling it.
You fire, watch your energy dip and refill, and get a kill by leading the shot.
You sit inside the ring, it fills cyan, and your team's score starts ticking: the hook lands as the beacon drifts on and the enemy fleet turns to follow it.
*(guessed)*
Bots fight properly from the start but miss sometimes and react a beat late.
From about minute 2 the enemy fleet moves in groups to retake beacons.
Dying costs a few seconds and gives the enemy a point; a bigger zone fight later means three beacons contested at once.
*(provisional)*
